download_and_retention.local_retention_of_already_downloaded_co: No separate duration was found in public DataCube pages reviewed; ask JPX if a contractual retention limit is required. Project policy is local-only.

raw_data_policy: Never download raw market files into Work/Cloud/ChatGPT; purchase and download only on the human local PC. Never upload raw files, rows, mapped values, or reconstructable extracts.
